G3800.et: from a presumed derivative of the same as (3795)
G3800.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as «3795»; rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay:-- wages.

G3801.o: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
G3801.et: a phrase combining (3588) with the present participle and imperfect of (1510) and the present participle of (2064) by means of (2532)
G3801.def: a phrase combining «3588» with the present participle and imperfect of «1510» and the present participle of «2064» by means of «2532»; the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ:--which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be).

G3803.def: from «4078»; a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation):--snare.

G3804.def: from a presumed derivative of «3806»; something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence:-- affection, affliction, motion, suffering.

G3805.def: from the same as «3804»; liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain:--suffer.

G3806.def: from the alternate of «3958»; properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence):-- (inordinate) affection, lust.

G3807.et: from (3816) and a reduplicated form of (71)
G3807.def: from «3816» and a reduplicated form of «71»; a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("paedagogue")):-- instructor, schoolmaster.

G3808.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3816»; a little boy:--child, lad.

G3809.def: from «3811»; tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction:--chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture.

G3810.def: from «3811»; a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner:--which corrected, instructor.

G3811.def: from «3816»; to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment):--chasten(-ise), instruct, learn, teach.

G3812.def: adverb (of source) from «3813»; from infancy:--of a child.

G3813.def: neuter diminutive of «3816»; a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian:--(little, young) child, damsel.

G3814.def: feminine diminutive of «3816»; a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant:--bondmaid(-woman), damsel, maid(-en).

G3816.def: perhaps from «3817»; a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God):--child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.

G3817.pos:
1. to strike, smite
  2. to sting (to strike or wound with a sting)
G3817.def: a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than «5180»); specially, to sting (as a scorpion):--smite, strike.

G3818.pos:
Phrygia = "dry, barren"
  1. in the 4th century after Christ, Phrygia was divided into Phrygia Salutaris and Phrygia Pacatiana; Laodicea was a city in the latter
G3818.def: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia:--Pacatiana.

G3819.et: probably another form for (3825) (through the idea of retrocession)
G3819.def: probably another form for «3825» (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient:--any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past.

G3820.def: from «3819»; antique, i.e. not recent, worn out:--old.

G3822.def: from «3820»; to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete:--decay, make (wax) old.

G3823.et: from pallo (to vibrate, another form for (906))
G3823.def: from pallo (to vibrate; another form for «906»); wrestling:--+ wrestle.

G3824.def: from «3825» and «1078»; (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration:--regeneration.

G3825.et: probably from the same as (3823) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition)
G3825.def: probably from the same as «3823» (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand:--again.

G3826.et: dative case (adverb) of a compound of (3956) and (4128)
G3826.def: dative case (adverb) of a compound of «3956» and «4128»; in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously:--all at once.

G3827.def: from «3956» and «4183»; full many, i.e. immense:--very great.

G3828.et: from a compound of (3956) and (4443), every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous ((5561) being implied)
G3828.def: from a compound of «3956» and «4443»; every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (5561 being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pamphylia.

G3829.et: from a presumed compound of (3956) and a derivative of (1209)
G3829.def: neuter of a presumed compound of «3956» and a derivative of «1209»; all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan):--inn.

G3830.def: from the same as «3829»; an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai):--host.

G3831.def: from «3956» and a derivative of «58»; a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship:--general assembly.

G3832.def: adverb from «3956» and «3624»; with the whole family:--with all his house.

G3833.def: from a compound of «3956» and «3696»; full armor ("panoply"):--all (whole) armour.

G3834.def: from «3835»; adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry:--(cunning) craftiness, subtilty.

G3836.def: adverb (of source) from «3837»; from all directions:--from every quarter.

G3837.et: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of (3956)
G3837.def: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of «3956»; universally:--in all places, everywhere.

G3838.def: from «3956» and «5056»; full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion):--+ in (no) wise, uttermost.

G3840.def: adverb (of source) from «3956»; from (i.e. on) all sides:--on every side, round about.

G3841.def: from «3956» and «2904»; the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign):--Almighty, Omnipotent.

G3842.def: from «3956» and «3753»; every when, i.e. at all times:--alway(-s), ever(-more).

G3843.def: adverb from «3956»; entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event:--by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely.

G3844.def: a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of):--above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, × friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, × his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side...by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with. In compounds it retains the same variety of application.

G3845.def: from «3844» and the base of «939»; to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command:--(by) transgress(-ion).

G3846.def: from «3844» and «906»; to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken:--arrive, compare.

G3849.et: from (3844) and the middle voice of (971)
G3849.def: from «3844» and the middle voice of «971»; to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty):--constrain.

G3850.def: from «3846»; a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage:--comparison, figure, parable, proverb.

G3851.et: from (3844) and the middle voice of (1011)
G3851.def: from «3844» and the middle voice of «1011»; to misconsult, i.e. disregard:--not (to) regard(-ing).

G3853.def: from «3844» and the base of «32»; to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin:--(give in) charge, (give) command(-ment), declare.

G3854.def: from «3844» and «1096»; to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly:--come, go, be present.

G3855.def: from «3844» and «71»; to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away:--depart, pass (away, by, forth).

G3856.def: from «3844» and «1165»; to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy:--make a public example, put to an open shame.

G3857.def: of Oriental origin (compare «06508»); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise"):--paradise.

G3858.def: from «3844» and «1209»; to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in:--receive.

G3859.def: from a compound of «3844» and «1304»; misemployment, i.e. meddlesomeness:--perverse disputing.

G3860.def: from «3844» and «1325»; to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit:--betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.

G3861.et: from (3844) and (1391) (in the sense of seeming)
G3861.def: from «3844» and «1391» (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation, i.e. extraordinary ("paradox"):--strange.

G3862.def: from «3860»; transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law:--ordinance, tradition.

G3863.def: from «3844» and «2206»; to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry:--provoke to emulation (jealousy).

G3864.def: from «3844» and «2281»; along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine):--upon the sea coast.

G3865.def: from «3844» and «2334»; to overlook or disregard:--neglect.

G3866.def: from «3908»; a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust:--committed unto.

G3867.def: from «3844» and «134»; to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course):--admonish, exhort.

G3868.et: from (3844) and the middle voice of (154)
G3868.def: from «3844» and the middle voice of «154»; to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun:--avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject.

G3869.def: from «3844» and «2523»; to sit down near:--sit.

G3870.def: from «3844» and «2564»; to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation):--beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray.

G3871.def: from «3844» and «2572»; to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively):--hide.

G3872.def: from a compound of «3844» and «2698»; something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust):--that (thing) which is committed (un-)to (trust).

G3873.def: from «3844» and «2749»; to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy):--be present.

G3874.def: from «3870»; imploration, hortation, solace:--comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty.

G3877.def: from «3844» and «190»; to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to:--attain, follow, fully know, have understanding.

G3878.def: from «3844» and «191»; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey:--neglect to hear.

G3879.def: from «3844» and «2955»; to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within):--look (into), stoop down.

G3880.def: from «3844» and «2983»; to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn:--receive, take (unto, with).

G3881.et: from (3844) and the middle voice of (3004) (in its original sense)
G3881.def: from «3844» and the middle voice of «3004» (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past:--pass, sail by.

G3882.def: from «3844» and «251»; beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime:--sea coast.

G3883.def: from a compound of «3844» and «236»; transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness: variableness.

G3884.def: from «3844» and «3049»; to misreckon, i.e. delude:--beguile, deceive.

G3885.def: from a derivative of «3886»; as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic":--that had (sick of) the palsy.

G3886.def: from «3844» and «3089»; to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled):--feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy.

G3887.def: from «3844» and «3306»; to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere):--abide, continue.

G3888.et: from (3844) and the middle voice of a derivative of (3454)
G3888.def: from «3844» and the middle voice of a derivative of «3454»; to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console:--comfort.

G3891.def: from a compound of «3844» and «3551»; to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress:--contrary to law.

G3892.def: from the same as «3891»; transgression: iniquity.

G3893.def: from «3844» and «4087»; to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--provoke.

G3895.def: from «3844» and «4098»; to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize:--fall away.

G3896.def: from «3844» and «4126»; to sail near:--sail by.

G3897.et: from a compound of (3844) and the base of (4139) (as adverb)
G3897.def: neuter of a compound of «3844» and the base of «4139» (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost:--nigh unto.

G3898.def: adverb from the same as «3897»; in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly:--likewise.

G3899.def: from «3844» and «4198»; to travel near:--go, pass (by).
